edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Reduced mevalonate-pathway flux can affect muscle energy handling and membrane stability, which is why myalgias remain a plausible adverse effect even though nocebo responses also inflate symptom reporting.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Kovacic meta analysis in J Nutr Sci, which ties statins to statin-associated muscle symptoms in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
